title: Capability
description: A reusable system or architecture node in this project's capability graph. Cross-project discovery requires an external registry or federation binding.

kind.description: component = a standard building block any app can adopt; skeleton = a named set of components applied in one step (see hub_core/catalog.py).

what.description: What it is / does, in the reader's terms.

when.description: When to adopt it — and when it is NOT a fit.

get.description: How to adopt it: what to copy or link, and from where.

entry.description: Where it enters an app (template, route, script tag, module).

delivery.description: component: copied into the app, hosted once and linked, or installed as a package.

hosted_at.description: component with delivery=hosted: the URL apps link.

exemplar.description: A live instance worth opening before adopting.

default.description: component: part of the standard starting set; skeleton: the one used when none is named.

applies.description: skeleton: the components it applies, in order. Never restates their steps.

applies_all.description: skeleton: take EVERY component, ordered by each one's depends_on (ties keep registration order).

pivot_notes.description: How to reference/pivot this into a future project.

needs.description: What it still needs (doubles as cross-project backlog).

depends_on.description: What must be in place first; for components this is the order a skeleton applies them in.
